title: BehaviorBench population-mean prior (prior_marginal) — 2026-11-12
license: Dataset CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (eval only, not redistributed). Evaluator MIT.
mg_cursor_note: Does not advance MG-02. External calibration only; MG-04 gate remains MaMe-Re.

definition.prior_marginal_full: Grouped empirical mode (classification) or mean (numeric) on the official test split, including the scored item. Reproduces Muse full-split surv_resp_pred Acc 0.3944.
definition.prior_loo: Same grouped statistic with the scored item held out.
definition.prior_constant_mean: For first-round game_behavior: official protocol of N identical draws of the population mean (point mass).
definition.prior_constant_mode: Same protocol with the population mode.
definition.human_human_split_half: Not a model. Split human actions (50/150 when n=200) and measure W; seed 20261111, 200 repeats, to sit next to Muse's published human baseline.
